title: Water Rooms
content: Does anyone ever get stuck in the "water rooms". Aka the whole room is a giant pool with nowhere to get out of the water. The ceilings are high and the water is VERY deep and sometimes dark but also sometimes super clear. There is a big shark that stalks you too but he never gets you. The only place to get out of the water is little ledges that hang or random pool ledges/stairs in the middle of the room. The rooms are hot and humid. You can get to other rooms via doorways on the walls...but it is just another water/pool room. Anyone else??
